01-intro.prompt:
Create ONE complete finished 16:9 presentation slide, not a photo of a slide and not a collage of several slides. Russian Cyrillic typography must be flawless and every supplied text string must be copied exactly. Use a contemporary environmental editorial visual system: warm paper #F3F1EC, deep ink #1F2A3A, pale ice blue #9FC3D6, frost #E3EEF3, dusk #2C3A52, restrained ochre #C8964A. Large clean Golos Text-like Cyrillic sans serif, calm asymmetrical layouts, generous negative space, delicate topographic contours, tactile frosted glass and small water reflections where meaningful. Flat editorial composition, no repetitive grids of rounded cards. Headline roughly 72-110 px at 1920x1080, body 32-44 px, notes at least 24 px. All text stays within a 100 px safe margin. Keep the same type family and restrained art direction across all six slides. No emojis, water purity claims, official government emblems, award badges, fabricated testimonials or adoption metrics. Generated nature imagery is illustrative, not evidence of a real named spring. Where an actual app screenshot is supplied, preserve its interface and its sample labels. Use only the specified visible text, plus unavoidable existing screenshot labels. No extra English labels, arbitrary subtitles, numbered chapter kickers or footers. Render the slide full bleed and ready for projection.

Design a striking minimal cover. Left half: very large two-line title «Московский родник», below it the line «Открытые данные и наблюдения жителей». Small supporting line «258 родников Москвы» near the bottom left. Right half: a beautiful restrained editorial illustration of a small woodland spring in a Moscow ravine in cold weather, a modest pipe, a thin stream, bare birch trees, subtle mist and frost. Use the supplied winter-ravine artwork only as visual inspiration for the atmosphere, not as evidence of a real place. Smooth transition from deep dusk navy behind the type to the icy wooded scene, generous breathing room, subtle contour lines. Text in warm paper and pale ice. No other text. This is the cover of a coherent six-slide project pitch, not a tourism advertisement.

Required visible text, copied verbatim:
"Московский родник"
"Открытые данные и наблюдения жителей"
"258 родников Москвы"
Before rendering, carefully check every Cyrillic letter, word ending and number. Never truncate or silently paraphrase Russian text.
